dedupe_keys.name: mapbiomas monitor da mineracao brazilian mining titles crossed with mapped mining areas beta

description: A web platform that joins Brazil's active mining titles with the mining class mapped by MapBiomas, to flag signs of administrative inconsistencies. The platform's information note says version 1.2 (beta) crosses the polygons of active mining processes from the SIGMINE system of the National Mining Agency (ANM) with the mining class of MapBiomas Collection 10 (Landsat, 30 m), and adds official metadata such as process phase, holder, substance and CFEM royalty payments, which are refreshed from official sources. Filters cover biome, process phase, temporal inconsistency, mining beyond the licensed area, CFEM payment, substance, expected mining not detected, and process year from 1934 to 2026; it listed 270,105 mining processes, last updated 26 September 2026. A counting error in the first beta of 2 December 2025 was corrected on 3 December 2025. Data are public and free to view in the browser under CC BY with citation; a bulk download format is not stated on the page read. Coverage is Brazil. Caveats: only active processes are included, Landsat misses small workings, and MapBiomas makes no judgement of legality. For simulation it locates formal and informal mining against licences, to map pressure on rivers, dams and roads in mining regions. Related catalogue records include the Maus global-scale mining polygons and the MapBiomas land cover collections.
